networkAccess.reasoning: Figma's plugin sandbox enforces browser CORS, and Pinterest's servers don't send CORS headers, so board/pin-feed data is fetched through a small self-hosted Cloudflare Worker proxy (worker/pinterest-proxy.js) that fetches Pinterest server-to-server and adds CORS headers. Scoped to this specific deployed worker rather than *.workers.dev, since the exact hostname is known (redeploying to a different worker name requires updating this alongside src/config.ts). Once fetched, each pin's image is downloaded directly from Pinterest's CDN (i.pinimg.com) to place it on the canvas — that call doesn't go through fetch()/CORS since it uses figma.createImageAsync().
